patthana9.1:2.1: nahetu nakusalo → na sauttaro (bj) | nahetū → na hetu (bj) | nanahetu nakusalo → na hetu na kusalo (bj) | nanahetuṁ nakusalo → na nahetu na kusalo (sya-all)
patthana9.1:11.1: nahetū kusale → na hetu kusalo (bj) | nahetu naakusalo → na hetu akusalo (bj)
patthana9.1:15.1: eko khandho nahetuṁ naabyākataṁ → na hetuṁ na abyākataṁ (bj, sya-all) | paṭicca → paṭicca na (sya-all)
patthana9.1:18.1: nava → nava na hetuṁ na sukhāya (bj); nava na hetuduka navedanāttikaṁ (sya-all)
